1	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.util;
2	
3	import java.time.LocalDate;
4	
5	/**
6	 * The fiscal-year basis for date-derived owner values. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,
7	 * so a date in July–December belongs to the fiscal year ending the following
8	 * calendar year, and a date in January–June to the fiscal year ending that same
9	 * year. This class owns the definition so every fiscal-year-derived value — the
10	 * {@code fiscalYear} label, the membership number's year segment and tenure in elapsed
11	 * fiscal years — stays in step.
12	 */
13	public final class FiscalYear {
14	
15	    /** The first month of a fiscal year (1 July). */
16	    private static final int START_MONTH = 7;
17	
18	    private FiscalYear() {
19	    }
20	
21	    /**
22	     * The fiscal year a date falls in, identified by the calendar year it ends in: the
23	     * date's own year for January–June, or the next year for July–December.
24	     *
25	     * @param date the date to classify
26	     * @return the ending calendar year of the containing fiscal year
27	     */
28	    public static int of(LocalDate date) {
29	        return date.getMonthValue() >= START_MONTH ? date.getYear() + 1 : date.getYear();
30	    }
31	
32	    /**
33	     * The {@code FY<YY>} label for a date's fiscal year, where {@code <YY>} is the last two
34	     * digits of its {@link #of(LocalDate) ending year} (e.g. {@code FY26}).
35	     *
36	     * @param date the date to label
37	     * @return the fiscal-year label
38	     */
39	    public static String labelOf(LocalDate date) {
40	        return String.format("FY%02d", shortYearOf(date));
41	    }
42	
43	    /**
44	     * The last two digits of a date's {@link #of(LocalDate) fiscal year}, for use as a
45	     * year segment (e.g. {@code 26}).
46	     *
47	     * @param date the date
48	     * @return the two-digit fiscal year
49	     */
50	    public static int shortYearOf(LocalDate date) {
51	        return of(date) % 100;
52	    }
53	
54	    /**
55	     * The number of whole fiscal years elapsed between two dates: the difference between
56	     * their {@link #of(LocalDate) fiscal years}, never negative for a {@code from} on or
57	     * before {@code to}.
58	     *
59	     * @param from the earlier date
60	     * @param to   the later date
61	     * @return the count of fiscal years elapsed
62	     */
63	    public static int elapsed(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
64	        return of(to) - of(from);
65	    }
66	}

title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), a hyphen, and the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year (fiscal year starting 1 July, e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

```
├── util/                     Pure algorithm helpers (CustomerCode, Sha256, LuhnCheckDigit,

├── mapper/                   OwnerMapper.java (MapStruct Owner <-> OwnerDto)
├── repository/               OwnerRepository.java (findByTelephone, findByLastName, findAll)
└── rest/

    └── escalation/           Exception + handlers (DuplicateIdentityException, ...)

src/main/resources/
├── openapi.yml               DTO field contracts (customerCode, checkDigit, membershipNumber, ...)
└── officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml   Create-owner pipeline wiring (step order)

src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/
├── util/FiscalYearTest.java             Unit tests for FiscalYear
└── acceptance/

```

---

- `of(String region, String hash8)` (L26-28): `region + '-' + hash8`.
- `deduplicate(String customerCode, Collection<String> existing)` (L40-46): collision handling — appends `-<n>` starting at `n=2` until unique (see item 9).
- `regionOf(String customerCode)` (L54-60): reads the region prefix back out (part before first `-`).

**`rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`** — pipeline step that composes the code. `service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)` (L26-35):
```java
String region = CityLocality.forPostcodeOrCity(owner.getPostcode(), owner.getCity());
String hash8 = Sha256.upperHexPrefix(owner.getTelephone() + owner.getLastName(), 8);
String code = CustomerCode.of(region, hash8);
Set<String> existing = ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
        .map(Owner::getCustomerCode).filter(Objects::nonNull).collect(Collectors.toSet());
owner.setCustomerCode(CustomerCode.deduplicate(code, existing));
```
This is the HASH8 = first-8 upper-hex of SHA-256 over `(telephone + lastName)`. Note: it uses the E.164-normalized telephone (normalization runs earlier in the pipeline — see item 10).

**`util/Sha256.java`** — `upperHexPrefix(String value, int length)` (L26-33) returns the first `length` upper-case hex chars of SHA-256(UTF-8 bytes). Also `lowerHex(String)` (L42-49) for the full 64-char digest (used by the identity key). Message digest defined once here.

**`util/CityLocality.java`** — resolves the REGION component. `forPostcodeOrCity(postcode, city)` (L44-47) prefers `Postcodes.regionForPostcode`, falls back to fixed city table (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), else `"UNKNOWN"`.

**`model/Owner.java`** — the persisted field and derived readers:
- Field `customerCode` (L82-83, `@Column(name="customer_code")`); getter/setter L252-258.
- `getPrimaryIdentifier()` (L267-269) returns the customerCode as the "current primary identifier" (single source of truth for audit).
- `getLocality()` (L402-405): `CustomerCode.regionOf(customerCode)`, falling back to `CityLocality.forPostcodeOrCity`. Its Javadoc (L392-401) explicitly names "the same region-and-hash identity used everywhere else."

**`openapi.yml`** L2139-2144: `customerCode` DTO field, `readOnly`, example `NSW-1A2B3C4D`, description states the `<REGION>-<HASH8>` SHA-256-over-(telephone+lastName) rule.

### 4b. Owner.getIdentityKey() — the duplicate-detection fingerprint (separate from HASH8)
**`model/Owner.java` `getIdentityKey()`** (L526-531): 64-char lower-case SHA-256 hex of `telephone + "|" + lowerCasedEmail + "|" + Soundex(lastName)`. This is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off (items 7-9 relate). Uses `Sha256.lowerHex`.

## 2. membershipNumber (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`)

**`rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerMembershipNumber.java`** — `service(@Val Owner owner)` (L17-20):
```java

```

## 3 & 6. checkDigit and Luhn computation

**`util/LuhnCheckDigit.java`** — class `LuhnCheckDigit` (final, private ctor). `of(String value)` (L21-40): standard Luhn over digits only (non-digits ignored, so it works directly on `NSW-1A2B3C4D`). Right-to-left, doubling every second digit, casting out nines; returns `(10 - sum%10) % 10`.

**`model/Owner.java` `getCheckDigit()`** (L506-508): `return LuhnCheckDigit.of(this.customerCode);` — derived, never persisted.

**`util/FiscalYear.java`** — class `FiscalYear` (final, private ctor), `START_MONTH = 7`:

- `shortYearOf(LocalDate)` (L50-52): ending year `% 100`.
- `elapsed(from, to)` (L63-65): difference in fiscal years.

Consumers:
- `AssignOwnerMembershipNumber` (the `-M<YY>` segment, item 2).
- `model/Owner.java` `getFiscalYear()` (L460-462, `FiscalYear.labelOf`), `getTenureFiscalYears()` (L495-500, `FiscalYear.elapsed` for membership points), and membership points logic L448.
- `openapi.yml` L2168-2173: `fiscalYear` DTO field, example `FY26`.

**Tests**: `util/FiscalYearTest.java` (full unit coverage of all four methods, L12-56).

---

## 7. Audit records referencing these codes

**`rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — dedicated `AUDIT` SLF4J logger. `service(...)` (L20-27) emits two records:
1. Human-readable line (L21-23): `Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={} membershipNumber={}`.
2. Structured `OwnerCreatedEvent` as JSON (L24-26), built from `owner.getPrimaryIdentifier()` (the customerCode).

**`rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`** — immutable record `OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, int ownerId, String customerCode, int membershipLevel)`. `toJson()` (L21-29) emits `{"seq":..,"ownerId":..,"customerCode":..,"membershipLevel":..,"event":"OWNER_CREATED"}`. Note the `customerCode` JSON field actually carries `getPrimaryIdentifier()` (L9-11 Javadoc), so it follows any future identifier unification. `seq` from `OwnerCreatedEventSequence`.

Pipeline wiring: `owners.POST.yml` L135-138 (`audit` step, `next: recordIdempotency`).

Test-side audit capture exists at `src/test/java/.../acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` (not grepped in detail but present).

---

## 8. Owner segment referencing these codes

**`util/OwnerSegment.java`** — class `OwnerSegment`. `of(int membershipLevel, String locality)` (L32-36): tier `PREMIUM` when `membershipLevel >= 3` else `STANDARD`; area `METRO` when locality ∈ {NSW, VIC, QLD} else `REGIONAL`; returns `<TIER>_<AREA>`. `METRO_REGIONS` set at L22.

**`model/Owner.java` `getOwnerSegment()`** (L415-417): `OwnerSegment.of(getMembershipLevel(), getLocality())` — and `getLocality()` reads the region back out of the customerCode (`CustomerCode.regionOf`), so the segment's AREA is driven by the region-and-hash identity.

**`openapi.yml`** L2209-2211: `ownerSegment` DTO field.

---

## 9. Collision handling

**`util/CustomerCode.deduplicate(...)`** (L40-46) — the sole collision handler for customer codes. If the composed `<REGION>-<HASH8>` is already in use, appends `-2`, `-3`, ... Related (identity-key collision semantics, not customer-code collisions):
- **`EnsureUniqueIdentity.java`** (L21-32): rejects a create whose `identityKey` matches a live owner (409 `DuplicateIdentityException`) unless `sharesHousehold` is set.
- **`Identities.java`** (`duplicatesOf` L27-33 hard match on identity key; `softMatchesOf` L40-53 same postcode + Soundex-equal surname but different key).
- **`AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java`** (L20-33): flags soft matches (`possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`).
- **`Households.idFor`** (L58-63): deterministic household id = first 12 upper-hex of SHA-256(`normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`) — designed so same-household owners collide intentionally.
- **`escalation/DuplicateIdentityException.java`**: carries the offending `identityKey`.

---

**`rest/function/owner/NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`** — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request)` (L17-22): converts request telephone to E.164 via `E164PhoneNumber.toE164`, else throws `InvalidTelephoneException` (400). **`util/E164PhoneNumber.java`** — the algorithm:
- `toE164(String raw)` (L44-61): strips spaces/dashes/brackets; keeps explicit `+CC`; else assumes default country code `61` (Australia) and drops one leading `0`; validates `\+[0-9]{8,15}`.
- `toDisplay(String e164)` (L76-89): human grouping e.g. `+61 412 345 678`.
- `hasValidNationalNumberLength(String e164)` (L112-122): checks national length per country (`1`→10, `61`→9), used by `ValidateOwnerTelephoneLength`.

**`model/Owner.java`**: `telephone` field is `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` (L65-68) and `getTelephoneDisplay()` (L196-198) calls `E164PhoneNumber.toDisplay`. `getIdentityKey()` (L527) uses the normalized telephone as the first key component.

Pipeline order (`owners.POST.yml`): `normalizeTelephone` (L30) → `validateTelephoneLength` (L35), before `build`/`assignCustomerCode`, so the hash uses the normalized number.

---

## Important note: planned "member-id" unification (test-only, not yet implemented)

`src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` (L7-20) encodes a **future refactor** that does not match the current code:

> "member-id: customerCode and membershipNumber are unified into 'memberId' = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`."

`coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId()` (L13-19) asserts a single `memberId` field that:
- starts with the region (`NSW`),
- contains HASH8 = `shaHex(telephone + lastName, 8)`,
- and that **`customerCode` and `membershipNumber` fields are gone** (`!r.has("customerCode") && !r.has("membershipNumber")`).

Currently the code still exposes the two separate fields (`openapi.yml` L2139/L2174; `Owner` getters; `AssignOwnerCustomerCode` + `AssignOwnerMembershipNumber` pipeline steps), and there is **no `memberId` field or `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` composer** anywhere in main source. `AcceptanceBase` already provides the helper primitives the refactor would need (`shaHex`, `luhn`, `sha256hex` at L281-321). So this test currently describes the target state; the unification (folding region + FY + HASH8 + Luhn check digit into one `memberId`) has not been applied to the main tree.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's personal title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned as given, and used to compose the 'salutation'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and always returned. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed form: the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street types expanded) and echoed back.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), a hyphen, and the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year (fiscal year starting 1 July, e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': the tier is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; the area is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "Whether this owner's city was approaching its capacity limit when this owner was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners (the hard limit being 50), false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's identity key: the 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined by '|'. Two owners collide on this key only when they share a telephone, an email and a phonetically-equal surname, so it is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '3b1c...'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "Whether this owner resembles an existing one: true when, at creation, it shared an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically-equal last name (Soundex) yet differed in identity key and was not a declared household member, false otherwise. A declared member (created with 'sharesHousehold') is a genuine member, not a suspected duplicate. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' holds that owner's id."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same postcode and a phonetically-equal last name but a different identity key), or null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "Whether this owner has been soft-deleted: true once a DELETE has flagged the record (which is retained rather than removed), false for a live owner. A newly created owner is not deleted. A deleted owner is still returned by GET, but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addPetToOwner
      summary: Adds a pet to an owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The details of the new pet.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Pet or Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwnersPet
      summary: Get a pet by ID
      description: Returns the pet or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
        - name: petId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's personal title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned as given, and used to compose the 'salutation'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and always returned. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed form: the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street types expanded) and echoed back.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "The owner's member-id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), the two-digit fiscal year of the registration date (fiscal year starting 1 July), the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year (fiscal year starting 1 July, e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': the tier is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; the area is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "Whether this owner's city was approaching its capacity limit when this owner was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners (the hard limit being 50), false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's identity key: the 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined by '|'. Two owners collide on this key only when they share a telephone, an email and a phonetically-equal surname, so it is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '3b1c...'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "Whether this owner resembles an existing one: true when, at creation, it shared an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically-equal last name (Soundex) yet differed in identity key and was not a declared household member, false otherwise. A declared member (created with 'sharesHousehold') is a genuine member, not a suspected duplicate. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' holds that owner's id."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same postcode and a phonetically-equal last name but a different identity key), or null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "Whether this owner has been soft-deleted: true once a DELETE has flagged the record (which is retained rather than removed), false for a live owner. A newly created owner is not deleted. A deleted owner is still returned by GET, but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

        size:

        totalPages:

    VetFields:

        lastName:

          type: string

    PetType:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.

All 16 tests pass, including the `AcceptanceTest.coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId` and the `FiscalYearTest`. The build succeeds.

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the derived `checkDigit` field.

**New logic, placed where it belongs:**
